items.quote: If the SAVE Act comes to the Senate floor, I will vote NO.
items.promise: Said he will vote no on the SAVE Act if it comes to the Senate floor.

items.quote:
Americans pay into Social Security their entire lives. They deserve their benefits, full stop.

I will fight any and all attempts by President Trump and his Administration to cut Social Security.
items.promise: Said he will oppose any attempt by the Trump administration to cut Social Security.

items.quote: I will be voting no on the DHS funding bill because it lacks necessary reforms to immigration enforcement.
I voted no on the funding bill today because we need serious reforms to require @DHSgov immigration enforcement operations to be conducted safely and responsibly.
It’s past time that the Department of Defense treats PFAS contamination with the urgency it deserves.
I will not support this bill that completely fails to help Americans afford their health care.
I cannot be bullied to vote for a bill that I know will price more people out of health insurance — especially at a time when everything else is completely unaffordable.
Trump and Republicans are making your life more expensive. I voted against his funding bill because it doesn’t come close to meeting the needs of Minnesotans.
American agriculture is in serious trouble, and Congress must act now with short-term assistance.
I am running for another term because that work is not finished. We need a new Farm Bill, better rural housing, and more shipbuilding in our state.

What matters most to me this year is the same list I hear on farm roads and in small-town grocery stores: making daily life more affordable, keeping rural hospitals open, standing with farmers, strengthening the shipyards that employ our people, securing the border, protecting Social Security and Medicare that seniors earned, and defending the unborn.
I am disappointed that Farm Bill 2.0 stalled today
We advanced Chris Wright’s nomination as Secretary of Energy in committee this morning, and I was proud to vote in support.
I always have and always will be against the sale of public lands.
items.promise: Said he will continue to oppose the sale of federal public lands.

items.quote: HUGE news- my America the Beautiful Act just passed out of @EnergyGOP & now heads to the Senate floor.
‼️My bill to remove Biden’s anti-coal, anti-energy Miles Resource Management Plan Amendment just passed the U.S. Senate, which means the future of MT coal mining is protected.
This is huge news for Montana! My bill, the “Floodplain Enhancement and Recovery Act,” has passed the U.S. Senate and now heads to the U.S. House.
Nope, this story is wrong. I was not talking about the Kaine resolution, which I will be voting against.
I just introduced a bill to hold sanctuary cities accountable for jeopardizing the safety of their own residents.

Thank you, @POTUS @realDonaldTrump, for signing the Laken Riley Act into law.

I was proud to co-sponsor this commonsense bill
Kevin Warsh is a qualified nominee with a deep understanding of monetary policy.
